title: Demonic Organ in Ruins
description: A dark blue demonic figure with horns and claws emerges from a large pipe organ set within a crumbling gothic stone archway. Blue flames and dripping liquid surround the chained instrument while an open book titled 'SATANIS' lies on the debris-strewn floor in front.
prompt: A demonic blue figure with horns and claws rises from within a decaying pipe organ inside a ruined gothic cathedral archway, surrounded by blue flames and dripping blue liquid, heavy chains and padlocks hang from the organ, an ancient book titled SATANIS lies open on the stone floor covered in blue ooze, dark atmospheric fantasy scene with crumbling stone and debris
